headline: Russian Central Bank Bullion Reserves Drop to 2019 Levels as Gold Struggles
summary: Gold prices struggled to rally as new data showed Russia selling gold at its fastest pace since the 1998 debt crisis, lowering central bank bullion holdings to 2019 lows.
why: Large-scale liquidation of sovereign gold reserves can influence global precious metals supply dynamics and reflect severe domestic fiscal pressures.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Large-scale liquidation of sovereign bullion reserves increases global precious metals supply and depresses prices.
